== Summary ==
'''CardMaker recreation''' of [[Maneuver Check (V) (Errata)]] (<code>1210_45</code>, Virtual Block 1 slip 45), showing the '''PC-E1''' game text. No published image shows this text: the Virtual Block 1 release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB1-45-Maneuver_Check.png]]) and the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB1-D-maneuvercheck-pre.gif]]) both show the original text of [[Maneuver Check (V)]].

* '''Text source:''' Players Committee website card list (VBlock1Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064706/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock1Type.html 21 July 2012] (Internet Archive). The [Episode I] and Immune to Alter icons are drawn as on the printed slip; ‘blown away,’ keeps the slip's single quotes.
* '''PC-E1 text:''' “Deploy on table. Once per game, if Alderaan 'blown away,' may target a system; unless opponent has a capital (or [Episode I]) starship there, Objectives treat that system as a Subjugated planet. Starships may not move the turn they are deployed (or carried) to Death Star. (Immune to Alter.)”
* '''Made:''' 8 November 2026 with the SWCCG CardMaker (https://swccg.com/cardmaker/, repo billbisco/swccg-cardmaker), STANDARD rev 71: the card's own Virtual Legacy card (same Decipher art, frame, lore, icons, slip number and Virtual Block 1 set mark as the printed card) with the PC-E1 game text. Holotable size, 745 × 1039.
* '''Not an official image.''' Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
